1: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
2: """Net leaderboard: owner aggregate downloads, with ranxianglei (billion-context,
3: auto-install volume) flagged. Show #1..#9 raw, then #1..#12 after removing ranxianglei."""
4: import json, os, collections, urllib.request
5: SNAP = r"E:\test\rewrite-agently\.agents\skills\dsh-registry-track\snapshot"
6: fn = "snapshot-npm-2026.1023.9552.json"
7: d = json.load(open(os.path.join(SNAP, fn), encoding="utf-8"))
8: pl = d["plugins"] if isinstance(d, dict) and "plugins" in d else d
9: st = collections.Counter(p.get("downloadsStart") for p in pl if p.get("downloadsStart")).most_common(1)[0][0]
10: en = collections.Counter(p.get("downloadsEnd") for p in pl if p.get("downloadsEnd")).most_common(1)[0][0]
11: print("window %s~%s  version %s" % (st, en, d.get("catalog_version")))
12: def agg(plugins):
13:     o = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
14:     for p in plugins:
15:         ow = p.get("owner") or ""
16:         if not ow: continue
17:         o[ow][0] += 1; o[ow][1] += (p.get("downloads") or 0)
18:     return o
19: def nm(p): return p.get("name") or p.get("id") or ""
20: pkgmax = {p.get("owner"): (p.get("downloads") or 0) for p in pl}  # not used; keep simple
21: all_ = agg(pl)
22: rows = sorted(all_.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][1])
23: print("\nRAW #1..#9 (ranxianglei = the auto-install package to exclude)")
24: for i, (o, v) in enumerate(rows[:9], 1):
25:     # biggest package of this owner
26:     bp = max(((nm(p), p.get("downloads") or 0) for p in pl if p.get("owner") == o), key=lambda x: x[1])
27:     print("  #%d %-15s pkgs=%-3d dl=%9d  (top pkg %s=%d)%s" % (i, o, v[0], v[1], bp[0], bp[1], "  <-- 剔除" if o=="ranxianglei" else ("  <-- ME" if o=="drscrewdriver" else "")))
28: print("\nSum of #1..#9 raw: %d" % sum(v[1] for o,v in rows[:9]))
29: print("Sum of #2..#9 raw (excl ranxianglei): %d" % sum(v[1] for o,v in rows[1:9]))
30: # verify ranxianglei package = billion-context and its share
31: rx = sum((p.get("downloads") or 0) for p in pl if p.get("owner")=="ranxianglei")
32: tot = sum(v[1] for o,v in rows)
33: print("ranxianglei total %d = %.1f%% of ecosystem %d" % (rx, 100.0*rx/tot, tot))
34: # NET after removing ranxianglei
35: net = sorted([kv for kv in rows if kv[0] != "ranxianglei"], key=lambda kv: -kv[1][1])
36: print("\nNET #1..#12 after excluding ranxianglei")
37: for i, (o, v) in enumerate(net[:12], 1):
38:     print("  #%d %-15s pkgs=%-3d dl=%9d%s" % (i, o, v[0], v[1], "  <-- ME" if o=="drscrewdriver" else ""))
39: me = next(i for i,(o,v) in enumerate(net,1) if o=="drscrewdriver")
40: print("drscrewdriver NET rank = #%d" % me)

1: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
2: import json, os, collections
3: SNAP = r"E:\test\rewrite-agently\.agents\skills\dsh-registry-track\snapshot"
4: d = json.load(open(os.path.join(SNAP,"snapshot-npm-2026.1024.9903.json"),encoding="utf-8"))
5: pl = d["plugins"] if isinstance(d,dict) and "plugins" in d else d
6: def nm(p): return p.get("name") or p.get("id") or ""
7: ME="drscrewdriver"; OFFICE={"dsh-opensheet-sidebar","dsh-pptx-sidebar","dsh-docx-sidebar"}
8: 
9: # 口径B full list with owner's top package name
10: best=collections.defaultdict(lambda:(0,""))
11: for p in pl:
12:     o=p.get("owner") or ""; v=p.get("downloads")
13:     if not o or v is None: continue
14:     if v>best[o][0]: best[o]=(v,nm(p))
15: bl=sorted(best.items(),key=lambda kv:-kv[1][0])
16: print("### CALIBER-B #1..#34 (owner | pkg | value)")
17: for i,(o,(v,n)) in enumerate(bl[:34],1):
18:     print("%2d|%-16s|%s|%d%s"%(i,o,n,v,"  <== ME" if o==ME else ("  [SPAM]" if o=="ranxianglei" else "")))
19: 
20: # efficiency >=3 pkgs, ex-Office only for ME
21: agg=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
22: for p in pl:
23:     o=p.get("owner") or ""; v=p.get("downloads")
24:     if not o or v is None: continue
25:     if o==ME and nm(p) in OFFICE: continue
26:     agg[o][0]+=1; agg[o][1]+=v
27: eff=sorted([(o,v[0],v[1],v[1]/v[0]) for o,v in agg.items() if v[0]>=3],key=lambda r:-r[3])
28: print("\n### EFFICIENCY >=3pkgs ex-Office #1..#15 (owner|pkgs|sum|avg)")
29: for i,r in enumerate(eff[:15],1):
30:     print("%2d|%-16s|pkgs=%d|avg=%.0f%s"%(i,r[0],r[1],r[3],"  <== ME" if r[0]==ME else ("  [SPAM]" if r[0]=="ranxianglei" else "")))

(End of file - total 30 lines)
